[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) (i: Nat) (j: Nat) (found: Bool) : Bool :=
  match i, j with
  | _, _ when found => found
  | i, j when i = numbers.length => loop numbers threshold (i + 1) 0 found
  | i, j when j = numbers.length => loop numbers threshold (i + 1) 0 found
  | i, j =>
    let num_i := numbers.get! i
    let num_j := numbers.get! j
    let diff := (num_i - num_j).abs
    if diff < threshold then
      true
    else if i < numbers.length - 1 then
      loop numbers threshold (i + 1) (j + 1) false
    else
      loop numbers threshold 0 (j + 1) found
loop numbers threshold 0 1 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation numbers threshold
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_numbers_length_gt_1 := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil numbers.length
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- if result then spec
  simp [h_result]
  apply And.intro
  -- numbers_within_threshold
  apply And.intro
  existsi i, j
  have h_numbers_length := h_numbers_length_gt_1
  have h_i_lt_length := Nat.lt_of_add_eq h_i_lt_length
  have h_j_lt_length := Nat.lt_of_add_eq h_j_lt_length
  have h_i_ne_j := Nat.ne_of_add_eq h_i_ne_j
  have h_diff_less_threshold := (impl numbers threshold).right
  have h_diff_less_threshold' := (impl numbers threshold).left
  apply And.intro
  linarith
  -- else ¬numbers_within_threshold
  simp [h_result]
  apply And.intro
  simp [impl numbers threshold].right
  apply And.intro
  simp [impl numbers threshold].left
  apply And.intro
  simp [impl numbers threshold].right
  linarith
  -- program terminates
  have h_termination := Nat.finite_length numbers
  apply And.intro
  simp [h_termination]
  simp [impl numbers threshold]
  simp [h_termination]
  simp [h_numbers_length_gt_1]
  apply And.intro
  simp [h_result]
  simp [impl numbers threshold]
  simp [h_numbers_length_gt_1]
